title: Zohocorp Manageengine DDI Central build below 6500 are affected by a authenticated command injection vulnerability in…
description: Zohocorp Manageengine DDI Central builds below 6500 contain an authenticated command injection vulnerability in the Windows DDI Agent's clear_blocked_domains functionality. This flaw allows specially crafted blocked-domain values to execute arbitrary commands on affected Windows systems. The vulnerability has a high severity CVSS score of 9.1, indicating critical impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
